old_caption: The video shows a close-up view through the metal bars of a shopping cart, focusing on an orange plastic container inside. The container is partially visible, with its shape and color discernible through the grid. The background is out of focus, showing indistinct shapes and colors. The camera remains stationary, maintaining a consistent perspective on the container within the cart. There is no visible hand or other action occurring in the sequence.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up view through the metal bars of a shopping cart, focusing on the interior where various grocery items are visible. A person's hand reaches into the cart, placing an orange plastic container inside. The hand is partially visible, wearing a dark-colored sleeve, suggesting the person is dressed casually. The background is slightly blurred, emphasizing the action taking place within the cart. The lighting is bright, indicating an indoor setting, likely a store or supermarket. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining a consistent angle that captures the detailed interaction between the hand and the cart's contents. The video highlights the simple yet relatable act of shopping, focusing on the tactile experience of handling everyday items.
caption: A sharply focused silver metal wire grid, topped by a bent rail, fills the foreground while an out-of-focus orange container sits behind it. In the early frames the orange object stands roughly upright and toward the center-left, its elongated body visible through the mesh. The blurred backdrop shows a dark blue-black area beside a tan region on the right, with a small green shape resting at the lower-left. As the excerpt progresses the orange object slowly drifts toward the upper-right. During this movement it tilts and rotates so that its rounded base turns to face the camera, becoming the dominant visible part. By the later frames it holds a near-fixed position in the upper-right, showing only slight jitter. Throughout, the foreground grid stays stationary and in focus, with the camera fixed while the object moves behind it.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
